summary: Reviewed u44-86. Splits, cases and counts are sound; all 19 text_flags are plausible and kept as printed (src) with corrections only in words. Main problems: (1) Hindi omitted identifications and hedges the English carries (unduka, sirā, dhamanī, jarāyu, āmāśaya/pakvāśaya) and left आम bare (mango); (2) supplied nouns 'layer'/परत (not in the Sanskrit, unit 43 does not supply them); (3) u54 Hindi ungrammatical (सन्धि masculine); (4) u63 'अपान द्वार' invented; (5) numerals pañca/sapta tagged ind.; (6) snāyu rendered 'sinew' against sibling 'ligament'. Human decisions: u54 and u71 (guess built into translation vs. glossary rule), u57 split of upabṛṃhitā, u49 kāṣṭha case, u78 kolīyam (maybe klomam), u53 mastu. No identification judged wrong. No regrouping suggested; u71-78 correctly noted as a continuing statement, and u76-77 counts are as printed. Errors: 1, minor: 57.
glossary_suggestions: majjā = 'marrow' in anatomical contexts (p02), 'kernel' only in pharmacy units (existing glossary entry says kernel in all units: needs a scoped exception).
snāyu = 'ligament' (as in siblings ch05 k3/k4), not 'sinew'; sirā 'probably veins', dhamanī 'probably arteries' hedged in both languages.
unduka = 'probably the caecum' (Hindi उण्डुक यानी सम्भवतः अन्धान्त्र), always hedged.
āmāśaya = 'probably the stomach', pakvāśaya = 'probably the large intestine' wherever they occur (already in ch05 k5/k4 entries); Hindi bare आम/पक्व need 'यानी कच्चा/पका'.
prasāda = 'clear essence' (Hindi प्रसाद यानी स्वच्छ सार), consistent across u74-84.
maṇḍala = 'circle'; śukla-/kṛṣṇa-/dṛṣṭi-maṇḍala 'probably the white/dark part of the eye/pupil region', hedged.
vyāma = 'fathom, arm-span' (Hindi व्याम यानी फैलाई हुई दोनों बाँहों की लम्बाई).
āśleṣita = 'joined'; Śleṣmadharā 'Kapha-bearing'; kalā ordinal units supply no noun ('layer'/परत) in either language.
Hindi सन्धि (joint) is feminine: सन्धियाँ यानी जोड़.
Hindi apāyu = अपायु यानी गुदा; upastha = उपस्थ यानी जननेन्द्रिय.
OPEN: two glossary rules conflict on a guess for a damaged word (conjectural reading in translations vs. 'unclear' only; p02 ch05 u54, u71, u68, u85).
